cycles.method: Static, module-owned only: one event is the dearest UI tick transition (1,028 instructions, a coarse sum of every ts_tick site and maximum callee) plus the active frame path in the same block (12 enter, 9 leave), 1,049 instructions at 2.49216 cycles an instruction, Tuner's model. Instructions, not chip cycles: cache and bus waits are not modelled, and stock callees are excluded. Inactive frame cost is 4 + 4 instructions. Budget: Modwerk's ColdFire allowance, 10 % of a 362.8 us block. Not measured: no emulator or hardware cycle run was made for this package.

load.method: Not measured: no matched stock and module frame capture exists, and no value is substituted. The module adds at most 21 instructions to a frame.

stress.droppedExplanation: Not measured: Track Solo has no MIDI path of its own and no flood was run. Hardware use on 6 November 2026 was 300 s of functional playing, not a stress run.
